summary: Line runs into bush behind a house yard; no road or track to stop on.
reasons: No road edge here, only scrub

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush, but a house and shed sit just north of the line.
drivers.access_and_room: No formed track or tyre marks; the line crosses a private yard and tree cover.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street 20 m east, not usable from here.
drivers.convention: No signs; nothing to suggest parking is accepted.

flags: Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, mapped waterway 22 m away
Gate mapped 125 m south (not on the only access)
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the whole line.
